question: In October 2021, which of the following schemes got approval from the Cabinet to set up seven mega integrated textile and apparel parks inspired by the 5 F vision of Farm to Fibre to Factory to Fashion to Foreign?
solution:
The correct answer is** "PM MITRA".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM MITRA **is a government scheme that is launched by the** Ministry of Textile**.
 
• **Aim - **To help India to achieve United Nations Sustainable Development Goal which emphasizes building resilient infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, and fostering innovation.
 
• It also helps in making Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
 
• PM MITRA parks will offer the opportunity to create integrated textile chains from spinning, processing, and dyeing to manufacturing garments at one location.
 
• This will also reduce the cost of logistics and increase employment.
 
• Tamil Nadu, Punjab, Karnataka, and many states have shown interest in this field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM POSHAN -** The main motive of this yojana is to eliminate malnutrition. Under this scheme, the government provides freshly prepared one-time cooked meals in schools for students up to class 1. This scheme is introduced by the Ministry of Education. 
 
• **Ujjwala yojana** **-** Its objective is to safeguard the health of women and children by providing LPG cylinders so they don't have to cook meals in smoky areas. LPG cylinders are provided to BPL families and the connections will be named under women of households.
 
• **Jan Dhan Yojana - **Pradhan Mantri is the National Mission to ensure access to financial services, basic savings & deposit accounts, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner. Under the scheme, a basic savings bank deposit (BSBD) account can be opened in any bank branch. One basic savings bank account is opened in the name of a person having no account in the bank earlier. There is no minimum requirement to keep the amount in the account.
